verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party rule engine that fires actions automatically when an event occurs. Crossmint's spending rules, onchain transaction rules and scoped delegations are guardrails that constrain what agents may do, not triggers that start actions. Its webhooks (wallet, payments, auth) only send event notifications for a developer to build automation on, and the 'Policy engine' mention is undescribed, so none of these count toward this story.
